quickstart.step: Sign In & Launch from RollupOS Hub
quickstart.detail: Sign in with an authorized Google account (`visibility: restricted`) and launch **Adaptive Strength** from the RollupOS Hub dashboard.
Tap the `⚙️` button in the 29px Top System Strip to configure your personal preferences and review isolated profile storage.
Interact with the primary workspace actions (▶ Start, ↺, 90s, 60s, 45s)—all state saves automatically to your isolated user bucket.
Whenever a newer version is published, the Top System Strip automatically displays an `⬆️ Update` pill for 1-tap reload.
